Florida ranks #8 of 51 tracked states (86th percentile) with 762 verified live revenue-role openings across 154 employers. State-average hiring aggressiveness is 71/100 with a active tier skew (49% of roles).

The market tilts toward Adjacent Revenue Roles (23% of reqs) concentrated in Remote-first (92%). Miami: energetic, bilingual advantage (English/Spanish critical), international, hustle-forward. Tampa: growing tech scene, more corporate. Orlando: hospitality-meets-tech, tourism industry adjacency. Jacksonville: logistics, financial services.

KnowBe4 (Clearwater), Cloudflare, FIS, Salesforce — Miami FinTech and LATAM enterprise; Yardi and OpenDoor in property/proptech.
